style: Style: hand-drawn 2D vintage educational cartoon, bold slightly imperfect dark brown outlines, rounded hand-inked linework, flat colors with minimal cel shading, warm brown skin with peach highlights, palette of blueprint blue and hi-vis yellow accents, muted, with charcoal and warm greys, low saturation, vintage textbook look with clean digital coloring.
